notes.title: Oblitus Patch #2 Released
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

We've rolled out the second patch for Oblitus to address the issues seen on 32bit machines. This should fix the crash on launch or starting game problems on those configurations. 

We are hard at work on the next patch, but wanted to get this one out ASAP.  We are continuing to work on issues players report in the forums. Please let us know if you still experience load crashes after this patch goes out.  Thanks for playing! 

-ASG

notes.title: Oblitus Patch #1 Released
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We've rolled out the first patch for Oblitus to address the non-US / UK region based problems in the launch build. This should fix the disappearing character bug as well as many of the crash on launch or starting game problems.

Thanks again to our players and forum posters who helped us identify the cause of the issue. You guys are great! We are continuing to work on issues players report in the forums. Thanks for playing!

-ASG

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Oblitus, 20% off!
notes.content:
Oblitus is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Test your limits against a brutal and mysterious world as Parvus, a curious warrior with no memory and a heavy burden. Raise your spear and cast ancient spells as you battle hostile creatures and towering bosses in procedurally-generated 2D landscapes that are both beautiful and dangerous. Answer the call. Break the cycle. Change your destiny.
